_readme: Quick import template for Quiz sets. Keys that start with _ are ignored.
Each question: text (what is asked), image (optional), readAnswersAloud (true or false), answers (2 or 3).
Each answer: text (read aloud when picked), image (optional), correct (true for exactly ONE answer per question).
image: leave it as "" to upload the picture later in the editor, or paste a link that starts with https:// from the internet.
Question image: up to 2 MB, best at 600 x 300 px. Answer image: 84 x 84 px. SVG is best for sharp scaling (PNG, JPG, WebP also work).
Questions are added to the end of the current set. Press Save after importing.
